Pokemon type icons, converted from JSX to standalone SVG.

Source: https://github.com/Pokemon-Tectonic-Team/tectonic-tools
        (src/components/type_icons/components/*TypeIcon.tsx)

That repo's type_icons README states:
  "A set of SVG icons of Pokemon types. This is a recreation of the type
  icons found in Brilliant Diamond, Shining Pearl, Legends: Arceus,
  Scarlet, and Violet. [...] Free to use under MIT license."
  (originally from https://github.com/partywhale/pokemon-type-icons)

Mutant.svg is a Tectonic-specific addition from the same repo (reuses the
"unknown" glyph with its own color). Flex has no dedicated icon in either
project; trainer_cards.py falls back to QMarks.svg for it.
